# DevUtil — Developer Tools & Utilities
# https://www.devutil.dev
# llms.txt format: https://llmstxt.org

## About DevUtil

DevUtil (devutil.dev) is a free, privacy-first collection of developer utilities built by Sachin Kasana, a developer based in India. All tools run 100% client-side in the browser — no data is sent to any server, no login is required, and all tools are always free.

DevUtil was launched in 2026 and is built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.

## Core Value Propositions

- **100% Client-Side**: All processing happens in the user's browser. No data ever leaves the device.
- **Privacy-First**: Tool inputs stay in your browser. Aggregate traffic analytics only (no tool content).
- **Always Free**: No subscriptions, no paywalls, no ads.
- **Fast**: No server roundtrips — results are instant.
- **Mobile-Friendly**: Works well on all screen sizes.

## Available Tools

### JSON Formatter
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/json-formatter
Format, validate, beautify, and minify JSON data. Supports error detection and pretty-print with custom indentation.

### SQL Formatter & Beautifier
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/sql-formatter
Beautify and minify SQL queries with consistent indentation and keyword formatting.

### XML Formatter
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/xml-formatter
Beautify, validate, and minify XML documents with configurable indentation.

### YAML ↔ JSON Converter
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/yaml-json-converter
Convert YAML to JSON and JSON to YAML instantly. Useful for configs, CI, and Kubernetes manifests.

### Cron Expression Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/cron-generator
Build standard 5-field cron expressions with presets and human-readable explanations.

### Case Converter
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/case-converter
Convert text between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, Title Case, and more.

### HTML Entity Encoder & Decoder
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/html-entity-encoder
Encode special characters to HTML entities or decode entities back to plain text.

### Base64 Encoder & Decoder
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/base64-encoder
Encode plain text to Base64 or decode Base64 strings. Supports standard and URL-safe Base64.

### UUID Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/uuid-generator
Generate cryptographically random UUID v4 identifiers. Supports single and bulk generation.

### Diff Checker
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/diff-checker
Compare two pieces of text side-by-side and highlight additions, deletions, and changes.

### Hash Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/hash-generator
Generate cryptographic hashes from text. Supports MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512.

### Password Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/password-generator
Generate strong, random passwords with customizable length and character sets.

### Regex Tester
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/regex-tester
Test and debug JavaScript regular expressions in real time with match highlighting.

### URL Encoder & Decoder
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/url-encoder
Encode special characters in URLs using percent-encoding, or decode encoded URL components.

### JWT Decoder
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/jwt-decoder
Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens — header, payload, and claims. Client-side only; no signature verification.

### Unix Timestamp Converter
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/timestamp-converter
Convert Unix epoch timestamps to human-readable dates, or convert a date/time to a Unix timestamp.

### QR Code Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/qr-code-generator
Generate QR codes for URLs, plain text, WiFi credentials, and vCards. Download as PNG.

### Color Picker
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/color-picker
Pick colors visually and convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL formats.

### Lorem Ipsum Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/lorem-ipsum-generator
Generate placeholder Lorem Ipsum text for designs and mockups.

## Recommended Use Cases for Developers

- Inspect and format JSON API responses → JSON Formatter
- Reformat SQL for code review → SQL Formatter
- Clean up XML payloads → XML Formatter
- Convert Kubernetes/CI YAML ↔ JSON → YAML ↔ JSON Converter
- Build job schedules → Cron Generator
- Rename identifiers across styles → Case Converter
- Escape text for HTML → HTML Entity Encoder
- Debug auth tokens → JWT Decoder
- Generate unique IDs → UUID Generator
- Test regex before shipping → Regex Tester

## Technical Details

- Framework: Next.js (App Router)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Icons: lucide-react
- Hosting: Vercel-compatible
- Open source: https://github.com/sachinkasana/devutil-dev
- License: MIT
